steps.input:
def cand(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg or color==0: continue
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
          if 0<=r-dr<h and 0<=c-dc<w and grid[r-dr][c-dc]==color: continue
          run=[]; rr,cc=r,c
          while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==color:
            run.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
          if len(run)<2 or run[0][0]==0: continue
          a,b=run[0],run[-1]
          ex=[]
          for sr,sc,pt in ((-dr,-dc,a),(dr,dc,b)):
            cells=[]; rr,cc=pt[0]+sr,pt[1]+sc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==bg:
              cells.append((rr,cc)); rr+=sr;cc+=sc
            ex.append(cells)
          if bool(ex[0]) != bool(ex[1]):
            for rr,cc in ex[0] or ex[1]: out[rr][cc]=color
    return out
# parse each pair
pat=re.compile(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair \1 output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance|\nWrong attempts|\Z)',re.S)
pairs=[]
for m in pat.finditer(texts):
    n,h,w,ins,outs=m.groups()
    ig=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in ins.splitlines()]
    og=[[int(v) for v in row.split()] for row in outs.splitlines()]
    pairs.append((int(n),ig,og))
print('parsed',len(pairs),[(n,len(i),len(i[0])) for n,i,o in pairs])
print([(n, cand(i)==o) for n,i,o in pairs])

program='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(
        set(value for row in grid for value in row),
        key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid),
    )

    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or color == 0:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                if len(run) < 2 or run[0][0] == 0:
                    continue

                r0, c0 = run[0]
                r1, c1 = run[-1]
                extensions = []
                for sr, sc, er, ec in ((-dr, -dc, r0, c0), (dr, dc, r1, c1)):
                    cells = []
                    rr, cc = er + sr, ec + sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        cells.append((rr, cc))
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
                    extensions.append(cells)

                if bool(extensions[0]) != bool(extensions[1]):
                    for rr, cc in extensions[0] or extensions[1]:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(program)
ns={};exec(p.read_text(),ns)
checks=[(n,ns['transform'](i)==o) for n,i,o in pairs]
